Name: Simple Town Chatter (Big Update) Again
Author: Xsyy
Description:
[center][size=6][b]✦ Simple Town Chatter ✦[/b][/size]

[size=5][color=#FFE680][b]💜 If you enjoy my mods, please consider endorsing this mod. Thank you for your support! ⭐[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[size=4]PC 1.31 main download • Android 1.7 separate optional edition. Install one edition only.

[size=5][b]💬 Dialogue & reactions[/b][/size]

5,878 spoken entries for 34 original villagers, including everyday greetings, birthday remarks and 12 supported festivals. Friendship/actual relationship state shape exchanges; Krobus remains a platonic roommate. Named pets, your own horse and nearby farm animals can join short exchanges. Optional morning conversations with eligible awake spouses/roommates/pets run at most once daily. Native dialogue and scripted scenes take priority.

Farmer monster-encounter/victory reactions cover ten supported families with fallbacks. Victory follows actual kill ownership; raised slimes and reviving mummies are excluded. World observations respond to actual weather, time, surroundings and activity rather than inventing successes. Combat, drops, XP and NPC schedules remain unchanged. Eligible custom NPCs may listen; this does not add authored expansion replies.

[img width=760]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53536/53536-1791518369-237906578.png[/img]
[i]Dialogue and farmer-reaction examples: isolated native-renderer previews, not installed-save screenshots.[/i]

[size=5][b]🎮 Public chat & optional integrations[/b][/size]

Public typed messages appear above the actual connected speaking farmer, preserving original words/emoji. Commands, private messages and system notices are excluded; STC does not resend chat. With separate [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/48970]Pet Follow[/url], enable its chat-call option plus STC Player chat bubbles/Farmer speech and type the pet’s name publicly. Pet Follow owns follow/stay behaviour and its conditions; STC does not teleport or restore pets.

Optional Muttering Farmer compatibility pauses automatic farmer remarks while retaining NPC chatter. The optional Simple Dynamic Dialogues priority bridge yields activity during STC reading.

[size=5][b]⚙ Settings[/b][/size]

Use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] or config.json. Choose frequency, NPC/farmer speech, Classic/Rounded/Cloud bubbles, independent speaker colours and 25–100% background opacity (default 100%). Horizontal/vertical offsets range −200 to +200 pixels, default 0. Hide vanilla ambient bubbles starts Off; when enabled it hides routine native greetings/location/arrival remarks, including other mods using those routines. Dialogue, scripted events, emotes and direct speech API remain. It is inactive with Chatter Mode Off.

Performance caching starts On with 128 entries; choose 64/128/256/512. Larger caches use more memory. Existing speech retains reading time during tool use while unrelated new chatter waits.

[size=5][b]🌍 Requirements, languages & limits[/b][/size]

PC needs Stardew Valley 1.6 / SMAPI 4+. Android uses the separate compatible SMAPI 4.3.2+ edition; Android 1.6.15.3 native references were checked, but physical-phone/full Android modpack testing remains pending. Keep config.json and data when updating. No other Simple mod is required.

Each edition includes 5,985 text entries per language: 5,878 spoken and 107 settings/help entries across all 12 game languages. Player chat stays in its author’s language. Translations were authored with GPT and independently AI-reviewed; fluent-speaker review remains pending. Stardew Valley/native artwork belong to ConcernedApe; thanks to SMAPI/GMCM maintainers and feedback contributors.

[size=5][b]🐛 Bug Reports & 💡 Suggestions[/b][/size]

Report your mod/edition, game and SMAPI versions, platform, expected versus actual behaviour, and steps to reproduce. Include a [url=https://smapi.io/log]SMAPI log[/url] and a screenshot or video if useful. For suggestions, explain the change and how it would help.[/size]
